categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection and ecological restoration. Its main business segments include environmental remediation (soil and groundwater remediation, water body restoration), industrial pollution source treatment (industrial wastewater, waste gas, and solid waste treatment), and sales and services of environmental protection products. The company provides comprehensive environmental governance services and EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) contracting, along with technical consulting and operation management services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced core technologies such as high-concentration hexavalent chromium long-term stabilization, in-situ injection and circulation extraction combined remediation for soil and groundwater, high-efficiency chemical oxidation and odor control for organic polluted soil, high-salinity and high-nitrogen industrial wastewater treatment, ECORs electro-catalytic oxidation, VOCs adsorption-desorption and solvent recovery, and sludge biological leaching deep dehydration technology. It employs EPC and PC contracting models, integrating design, procurement, construction, and operation, supported by digital and intelligent environmental management platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, local investment platforms, state-owned enterprises, listed companies, municipal departments, water utilities, and large industrial enterprises, especially in pharmaceutical, chemical, photovoltaic, and lithium battery sectors. The company serves markets requiring environmental remediation of polluted sites, industrial wastewater and waste gas treatment, and municipal environmental infrastructure. Its projects span soil and groundwater remediation, water body ecological restoration, and industrial pollution control.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in the East China region, including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Anhui, Shandong, and extends its market reach to other economically active regions such as Hubei, Chongqing, and Guangdong. It has established a strong presence in Zhejiang province and is expanding into other provinces with significant market potential. The company’s projects and services cover multiple provinces across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zone-King Environmental Sci&Tech Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain. It provides integrated environmental governance solutions, including design, engineering construction, and operation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive service provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user. The company also sells environmental protection equipment and provides related technical services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on technology-driven growth, emphasizing innovation in environmental remediation and pollution source control. It pursues a dual-drive development strategy focusing on environmental restoration and pollution source governance, with long-term goals in digital intelligence, equipment manufacturing, and resource utilization. R&D efforts target advanced remediation technologies, digital environmental monitoring, intelligent operation platforms, and resource recovery, supported by collaborations with academic and research institutions. The company aims to enhance core technology patents and develop standardized equipment for industrial pollution control.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through EPC and PC contracting for environmental governance projects, technical consulting services, and sales of environmental protection equipment. The company recognizes revenue based on contract progress for engineering projects and upon delivery and acceptance for product sales and technical services. It also earns income from operation and maintenance services under entrusted management contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading private enterprise in China’s environmental remediation and industrial pollution control sectors, recognized for its strong technical capabilities and comprehensive service offerings. It competes with state-owned enterprises and other private environmental firms, leveraging its innovation, project experience, and regional market penetration. The industry is characterized by increasing competition from state-owned capital and local environmental groups, but the company maintains competitive advantages through technology and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 346.8 million, a 41.09% increase year-over-year, reflecting recovery from prior social mobility restrictions. However, it recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 120.9 million, with a decline in net assets by 30.07% to RMB 281.1 million. The company’s gross margin was 10.83%, impacted by industry competition and government budget constraints. It invested RMB 29.1 million in R&D, representing 8.38% of revenue. The company’s financial scale is mid-sized within the environmental sector, with growth potential tempered by current profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies and integrated environmental governance solutions as key differentiators. It offers comprehensive one-stop services covering site investigation, risk assessment, customized remediation design, engineering implementation, and long-term operation management. Its patented technologies address complex pollution challenges with high efficiency, stability, and resource recovery, such as long-term stabilization of heavy metals and innovative VOCs recovery. The integration of digital intelligence platforms enhances project management and environmental monitoring, providing clients with superior service quality and environmental compliance assurance.
